rationale.min_test_auc_roc: Candidate must clear a minimum discrimination floor on the held-out temporal test split.
rationale.max_expected_calibration_error: Displayed probabilities and score bands must be calibrated enough for lending-adjacent use.
rationale.max_individual_fairness_flagged_share: Similar applicants should rarely receive materially different scores.
rationale.max_individual_fairness_score_gap: Large score gaps between similar applicant profiles require review before promotion.
rationale.max_subgroup_auc_gap: Subgroup ranking performance must stay close to the overall model.
rationale.max_post_governance_auc_drop: Post-model governance adjustments must not materially damage model ranking quality.
rationale.max_post_governance_approval_rate_drop: Large approval-rate swings from governance adjustments are advisory review items.
rationale.max_drift_psi_alert: Feature-distribution drift at or above alert level blocks promotion.
rationale.score_dist_min_median: A median below 580 indicates the score mapping is collapsing all applicants into Poor — the exact failure mode in v1 (factor=40, median=529). Gates block this before it ships.
rationale.score_dist_max_median: A median above 700 indicates the mapping is inflating scores — weak applicants land Good/Excellent incorrectly.
rationale.score_dist_min_p95: The 95th-percentile score must reach Good territory (>=720). If it does not, the upper scale is unreachable by real applicants.
rationale.score_dist_min_good_plus_share: At least 15% of the population must score Good or Excellent (>=650). A value below this means the mapping treats nearly everyone as high-risk regardless of actual signals.
rationale.score_dist_max_reachable: The highest score in the population must reach at least 760. A ceiling below this means Excellent is mathematically unreachable — as it was under factor=40 where max was 683.
